name: state
meaning: 1 wait for GF_FADE_IN to clear, 2 appearing with the hint camera running, 3 wait for the pad release then unfreeze, 4 idle/readable, 5 wait for release after USE, 6 showing the tip box, 7 armed on CHECKPOINT (counting deaths), 8 armed on TRAJBOXES, 9 trajectory done and waiting for distance.

name: wolfFrozen
meaning: Non-zero while this sign holds the Wolf frozen: set from the reply of msg 0xe, and recomputed in states 2 and 3 as (msg 0xf returned 0) with neg/sbb/inc, so a refused unfreeze is retried on later frames. The freeze is owned per sign, not globally.

name: camRecord
meaning: PROPERTY_SIGNTIPS_CAMERA (prop 0) via Scn_GetPropCamera 0x5156ac: the camera setup record {u16 focal; s16 rot[3]; Vec3s eye}, whose words 0/2/4/6 and +8 block are the arguments of Camera_StartScripted.

name: rebirthCount
meaning: Number of respawns so far with Ralph inside checkpointBox; incremented once per Reset (0x4f21d7).

name: rebirthsNeeded
meaning: PROPERTY_SIGNTIPS_NBREBIRTH (prop 0x10), narrowed to a byte; the tip fires once rebirthCount reaches it (0x4f21ea cmp / jl).

name: checkpointBox
meaning: PROPERTY_SIGNTIPS_CHECKPOINT (prop 4); Reset only counts a death when Ralph is inside it, and the test is XZ only - it compares +4/+0xa and +8/+0xe and skips the vertical pair +6/+0xc.

name: boxVisited
meaning: One flag per TRAJBOXES entry, set to 1 when Ralph enters that box; state 9 begins once all trajBoxCount flags are set. Capacity 10 = (0xa0-0x78)/4, but both loops are bounded only by trajBoxCount, so a longer list would overwrite trajBoxes and trajBoxCount.

name: trajBoxes
meaning: zone list {boxes, count}: Pointer array returned by Scn_FindIdList 0x560846 for PROPERTY_SIGNTIPS_TRAJBOXES (prop 0x14). | count (+4): Element count written through Scn_FindIdList's u16 out-parameter, which is passed as this+0xa0+4 (0x4f1f91); read with movzx word at 0x4f2424 and 0x4f24fb.

name: triggerDist
meaning: PROPERTY_SIGNTIPS_DIST (prop 8): in state 9 the hint camera only starts once Wolf msg 0x41a returns more than this. The compare at 0x4f2553 is `jbe`, i.e. unsigned.

name: tipText
meaning: Localised tip string from Text_GetClassString 0x50fe66 with PROPERTY_SIGNTIPS_INDEXTEXT (prop 0xc) narrowed to a byte; drawn every frame of state 6 by Ui_DrawSubtitleBox 0x53931b.

name: textRect
meaning: Screen rect handed to Ui_DrawSubtitleBox: left 0x32, top 0x32, right 0x200-0x64 = 0x19c, bottom 0xf0-0x64 = 0x8c. Four s16 ending at 0xb8 = obj_size.
